title: PLANET GS-5220-8P2T2S (hardware version 3.0) firmware versions before 3.2412b261008 contains a stack-based buffer…
description: A stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability exists in PLANET GS-5220-8P2T2S (hardware version 3.0) firmware versions before 3.2412b261008. This flaw allows unauthenticated attackers to send an HTTP request with an oversized webstax_auth cookie, leading to stack memory corruption and potential denial of service.
